summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MeetFlow Phase 6 features including Lobby system, Host Panel controls, Recording/Transcript APIs, Enhanced breakout rooms, Chat announcements, Meeting policies CRUD, Organization settings, Attendance events, AI Insights & Action Items, Calendar events with RSVP, and Enhanced participant status

minor_issues.issue: Required JSON data with room_count parameter but test was sending empty POST
minor_issues.impact: Fixed during testing - endpoint works correctly when proper data is sent

passed_tests: Admin login and authentication
Lobby API: GET /api/meetings/{id}/lobby returns waiting participants
Lobby API: POST /api/meetings/{id}/join-lobby checks lobby_enabled
Host Control: POST /api/meetings/{id}/host-control mute_all, toggle_chat, toggle_reactions
Recording: POST /api/meetings/{id}/recording/start and /stop creates recording entry
Transcript: POST /api/meetings/{id}/transcript/start and /stop creates transcript entry
Breakout: POST /api/meetings/{id}/breakout-rooms/auto-assign distributes participants
Breakout: POST /api/meetings/{id}/breakout-rooms/broadcast sends messages
Breakout: POST /api/meetings/{id}/breakout-rooms/close-all closes all rooms
Chat: POST /api/meetings/{id}/chat/announcement creates host message
Policies: CRUD /api/admin/policies - create, list, update, delete
Organization: GET/PUT /api/organization
Attendance: GET/POST /api/meetings/{id}/attendance
AI Insights: POST /api/meetings/{id}/insights/generate (working with real LLM)
Action Items: CRUD /api/meetings/{id}/action-items
Calendar: GET /api/calendar/events returns events with RSVP status
Calendar: PUT /api/calendar/events/{id}/rsvp updates RSVP status
Admin Page: Policies tab with create/list/delete policies
Live Meeting: Host Panel button visible for hosts with lobby/mute-all/recording/transcript/announcement controls
Participant Panel: Shows connection status dot and host badge
Chat Panel: Host announcements integration
Meeting Controls: All buttons functional (mic, camera, reactions, chat, participants, host panel)
Host Panel: Mute all, recording toggle, transcript toggle, chat/reactions toggles, announcements
Frontend-Backend Integration: All Phase 6 APIs properly integrated with UI
